prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need a residential or commercial tester, and is this for Liberty city water customers (inside Liberty) or nearby rural Clay County? If you want, I can look up specific companies and phone numbers — tell me the city/zip and I’ll search.

Until then, here’s how to find and vet backflow testing/repair near Liberty, MO plus a few quick options to try:

Where to check first
- Contact the City of Liberty Water Department / Utilities. Many cities maintain a list of approved/certified backflow testers or can tell you the requirements for test reports they accept.
- Search Google Maps/Yelp/Angi for “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester Kansas City metro.” Most testers list “backflow prevention” or “backflow testing” in their services.

Common providers that serve the Kansas City / Liberty area
- National plumbing chains with KC branches (Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter) — they often do backflow testing/repairs.
- Local plumbing and irrigation companies — many local plumbers and sprinkler companies advertise certified backflow testing.
(If you want, I can pull up a current list of specific local companies and contact info.)

What to ask and verify
- Ask for the tester’s certification/license number and that they’re certified to test backflow prevention assemblies (RPZ, double-check, etc.).
- Confirm they will provide the completed test report in the format the City of Liberty requires and will submit it if needed.
- Verify insurance and whether they handle repairs on-site (some testers only test and will refer repairs).
- Get an estimate for the test and, separately, for common repairs (typical test cost in this region: roughly $60–$150; repairs vary widely — $100 on up depending on parts/labor).

If you want, tell me:
- residential vs commercial,
- the Liberty address or zip,
and I’ll find specific companies and phone numbers for you.
